idea-plugin.name: Declutter Tree
idea-plugin.description:
Declutter Tree brings clean visual organization to your IntelliJ IDEA Project View by anchoring auxiliary metadata files to the bottom of folders and logically grouping Java elements by type.

🎯 The Problem It Solves

In standard IntelliJ IDEA projects, files are sorted purely alphabetically. Files like package-info.java end up jumbled right in the middle of your core business classes. Declutter Tree restores clean visual hierarchy to your project tree with zero configuration required.

✨ Key Features

  • ⚓ Bottom File Anchoring: Automatically forces designated auxiliary files (such as package-info.java) to the very bottom of their folder, below all standard files.
  • 📁 Folders Stay on Top: Directory hierarchy remains completely unaffected and stays pinned at the top.
  • 🏷️ Clean Type-Based Grouping: Organizes Java elements logically by their declaration kind: Interfaces → Abstract Classes → Classes → Records → Enums → Annotations.
  • 🔤 Alphabetical Precision: All files within each group remain strictly sorted A–Z.
  • ⚙️ Fully Customizable: Customize your preferred sorting order or add custom bottom files via Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Declutter Tree.

⚡ Built for Speed (Zero UI Lag)

  • EDT Protection: Runs inside the tree rendering loop with minimal overhead, preventing UI stutter or dropped frames during scrolling.
  • O(1) Fast-Path: Uses pre-compiled lookup sets and in-memory VirtualFile pointers without loading ASTs or hitting disk.
  • DumbAware: Remains fully functional and fast during background project indexing.
  • Tree State Preservation: Retains Git status badges, bookmarks, breadcrumbs, and selection state without flickering.
